screens.name: NowWhat App · Settings · Flic
screens.description: Flic settings: buttons, presses, and auction presets as three zones in the list view. Tapping a preset (or + New) drills into a focused preset editor with a back row; diagnostics nests the same way. Settings decides; live trusts.
notes: Rethink after redundancy feedback: presses = assignment (selects only), presets = recipes (only editor). No duplicated library.
The presses rows deliberately mirror the live drawer's per-gesture selects — one assignment mental model across settings and live.
List ↔ detail: preset editing and diagnostics each replace the list with one focused surface and a back row.

screens.name: NowWhat App · Settings · Chat
screens.description: Chat automation settings: moments, not machinery. Three moment cards own their messages and show the exact bubble chat will see — tokens and link chips drawn visually. Tapping a moment drills into a focused editor (back row returns to the list); rate limits and the send log nest the same way.
notes: Chat has no device — the connection is the seller's live chat session, shown as a status, not a setup zone.
Defaults carry the journey: the three essentials (welcome, congrats, follow plug) ship on; the empty state restores them in one tap.
The empty state previews the exact three moment cards it will turn on — ghosted, switches off — so empty → ready reads as the same cards lighting up.
List ↔ detail: editing a message or opening advanced replaces the list with one focused surface and a back row — no inline editors competing with the list.
